subagentStatusLine.command: r="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"; if [ -z "$r" ]; then p="$HOME/.whynot-cut/plugin-root.json"; [ -n "$WHYNOT_OPTIONS_FILE" ] && p=$(printf %s "$WHYNOT_OPTIONS_FILE" | sed -e 's/[\]/\//g' -e 's,[^/]*$,plugin-root.json,'); r=$(sed -n -e 's/[\][\]/\//g' -e 's/.*"root" *: *"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p' "$p" 2>/dev/null | head -n 1); fi; [ -f "$r/hooks/run_python.sh" ] && exec bash "$r/hooks/run_python.sh" "$r/hooks/subagent_status.py"; exit 0
